request.spec:
A button downloads the pools as a CSV file: a header line pool,member,share,cut then one line per
member, pools in the order added and members in the order added, a pool member as pool:<name>, the
cut as shown (empty when none).

agent.result_text:
All 4 tests in the spec now pass on `bin/e2e`. To get the last one through I had to change one thing outside the pools request.

**The export:** the main export test passed on the first run. The "Export pools (CSV)" button is in `src/main/frontend/features/pools/export.slot.tsx` and works as I described earlier.

**The extra change:** "export pools scenario 3" first failed on something unrelated to pools. A claim is deferred to 2026-03-28 and then voided, and the test expects its "deferred" flag to still show "yes". The app treated only OPEN claims as deferred, so a voided claim showed "no". That claim is the only one in the spec that is deferred and then voided.

I changed only what that flag shows, in `src/main/frontend/features/claims/defer.slot.tsx`: a voided claim now shows "yes" until its deferred-to date. I left the shared deferral rule alone, both in the front end and on the server. Totals and the overdue calculation depend on that rule, and changing it could have changed behaviour for other statuses, such as a deferred claim that moves to PENDING.

Decision for you: if voided claims should keep their deferral as a real rule rather than just on screen, it belongs in that shared rule. That's a separate change to claims, and you may prefer to review it on its own.
